share_path.description: Directory for runtime data: locks, logs, mounts.

profile_name.description: Name of the profile to use (overrides profile_id).

profile_id.description: Numeric or string identifier of the profile (used by ID, e.g., via CLI --profile-id).

local_backup.description: Create local backup before overwriting files during restore (equivalent to --local-backup).

no_local_backup.description: Temporarily disable local backup creation during restore (overrides local_backup; equivalent to --no-local-backup).

only_new.description: Restore only newer or missing files (equivalent to --only-new).

delete.description: Delete newer files in destination not present in snapshot (dangerous; equivalent to --delete).

keep_mount.description: Retain mounted snapshot path on exit (equivalent to --keep-mount).

no_crontab.description: Skip crontab entry installation (used only with check-config; equivalent to --no-crontab).

shutdown_after_backup.description: Shut down system after backup completes (equivalent to shutdown command usage).

extra_args.description: List of additional CLI arguments to pass (e.g., ['--quiet', '--checksum']).
